verdict.rationale: Chroma's own docs show embedding-based similarity search: it indexes automatically and returns the n most similar results for a query. A community comment mentions SPANN/SPFresh indexes, which supports approximate nearest-neighbor indexing. Nothing in the evidence documents configurable distance metrics, so only about half the story is shown. Missing for 10: documentation of configurable distance metrics (e.g., cosine/L2/inner product), first-party documentation of the ANN index type and its tuning.

support.subject: As a developer, I can run approximate nearest-neighbor similarity search over embeddings with configurable distance metrics

citations.quote: You can query the collection with a list of query texts, and Chroma will return the n most similar results.
Chroma will store your text and handle embedding and indexing automatically.
